page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block with red and black lines, an emblem woodcut below the text, then the imprint lines and a library stamp. Show-through text from the reverse page appears faintly in the right half, not transcribed. Digitiser's footer and manuscript pencil shelf mark are excluded.
page.l: Recens uterque è suis fontibus deductus,
page.notes: Red type: "ANNVS LVNÆSOLARIS", "ANNVS meré LVNARIS". Emblem woodcut with motto "LVX IN TENEBRIS LVCET" around a lamp in an arch, not transcribed as text beyond the motto. Oval library stamp reads "KONINKL. BIBLIOTHEEK TE SHAGE" and is omitted. The word "Matheseos" was read with some doubt; the imprint year is printed as CIↃ IↃC XXX, i.e. MDCXXX.
